title: Extremal functions and zero sets for the Dirichlet space
summary: We study the zeros of functions in the Dirichlet space. Using extremal functions, we produce a necessary and sufficient condition for a sequence of points in the unit disk to be a zero set of the classical Dirichlet space. This Shapiro-Shields type condition involves kernels of the harmonic Dirichlet space associated with measures depending on the zero sequence.
